entries.what: Rafael has brakes lab at Tamsen Valley College from 8 to 11, bleeding a caliper on the shop's practice rotor. Afterward he fills up the Tacoma at the Ruel Road station.
entries.outcome: Lab work finished and the truck is fueled for the week.

entries.what: Pickup soccer at Delgado Park in the evening with the usual Monday crowd.
entries.outcome: Sweaty and loosened up, home by 9.

entries.what: At night he watches engine teardown videos in bed before sleeping around midnight.
entries.outcome: Fell asleep partway through a transmission teardown.

entries.what: Engine performance class with Salas from 1 to 4. Dante pitches another auction Civic while they share a lab bench.
entries.outcome: Rafael diagnosed the misfire first, and told Dante he'd think about the Civic.

entries.what: Records voice-memo flashcards in the truck and plays them back while he runs errands for his mom.
entries.outcome: Ten new cards recorded for the G1.

entries.what: Dinner at home with Oscar and Gladys, who talk about the new lot's slow weeknight sales.
entries.outcome: Agreed to a longer setup on Thursday.

entries.what: Brakes lab from 8 to 11 at Tamsen Valley, then he sits down in the truck to start the Ortega Auto & Tire internship application.
entries.outcome: Basic fields done, cover letter still blank.

entries.what: Drafts the cover letter and writes that he can only start after family obligations. He asks the assistant if that sounds bad.
entries.outcome: Softened the wording but kept the mention of the stand.

entries.what: Rewatches his teardown videos at night and listens to flashcards once through.
entries.outcome: Went to bed on time.

entries.what: Engine performance class from 1 to 4. He tells Salas he is submitting the internship application tonight.
entries.outcome: Salas reminded him the recommendation depends on the G1 practice result.

entries.what: Submits the application to Ortega Auto & Tire for a spring internship, pending his ASE practice result.
entries.outcome: Application sent, waiting on the G1 practice result.

entries.what: Works the stand at the Ruel Road lot from 5 to 10 p.m., running the griddle while flashcards play from his phone.
entries.outcome: Busy night, sold out of revueltas by 9:30.

entries.what: Morning at home, then a quick lunch of leftover pupusas before picking up supplies for the stand.
entries.outcome: Restocked masa and curtido supplies.

entries.what: Halloween Friday: he works the stand from 5, with kids in costumes stopping by on the way to Calle Ortega. At 8:50 he leaves to get Dulce from Taquería Colima.
entries.outcome: Good night of sales and the stand left in his parents' hands.

entries.what: Picks up Dulce outside Colima, who is still in a costume headband from the Halloween rush, and drives her home to Marisol Gardens before returning to the lot.
entries.outcome: Dulce got home safely and he was back by 9:20.

entries.what: Stand shift at the Ruel Road lot in the evening, with Ximena helping on Saturday.
entries.outcome: Steady crowd, a smooth night.

entries.what: Morning setup help for his mother, then he tops off the generator oil before heading to the lot.
entries.outcome: Generator ran fine all night.

entries.what: After closing, he drives Ximena home in the Tacoma and talks about her birthday plans.
entries.outcome: Settled on a dinner idea.

entries.what: Sleeps in, then helps Oscar with tool and canopy upkeep before the Sunday evening stand.
entries.outcome: Canopy fixed and ready.

entries.what: Works the Sunday stand shift from 5 to 10 p.m. at the Ruel Road lot.
entries.outcome: Closed the week with decent sales.

entries.what: At night he listens to his flashcards in the truck and checks his schedule for the next week.
entries.outcome: Planned a study block for Monday.
